h1: Custom XLarge Lanyards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom xlarge lanyards at Perfect Imprints. Ideal for events with thick ID badges or multiple attachments. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Custom xlarge lanyards are designed for heavy-duty use, accommodating oversized ID badges, multiple keycards, or bulky attachments. With widths up to 1 inch and reinforced stitching, these lanyards hold up in industrial environments, trade shows, and large-scale events. Choose from woven, dye-sublimated, or recycled materials to match your branding needs. The extra length and strength ensure comfort and durability for all-day wear.
heroAltText: Custom xlarge lanyards in various colors with thick ID badge holders, perfect for bulk orders and events.
